title: Towards Inclusive Mobility Modeling: Characterizing and Evaluating Elderly Trajectory Patterns in Urban Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating synthetic trajectory generation models (a Markov chain and a Qwen3-4B LLM) trained on different age-stratified populations (elderly-only, young-only, and full population) by comparing the spatial and temporal metrics of their generated trajectories against empirical elderly mobility patterns.
